dish.title: Thai Turkey Larb Lettuce Wraps
dish.description: Ground turkey cooked into fine crumbles and dressed warm with lime juice, fish sauce, and chile flakes, then tossed with shallots, scallions, a fistful of mint and cilantro, and nutty homemade toasted rice powder. Spooned into butter lettuce cups with cool cucumber. Bright, herby, and on the table in under 30 minutes.

recipe_version.title: Thai Turkey Larb Lettuce Wraps
recipe_version.description: Ground turkey cooked into fine crumbles and dressed warm with lime juice, fish sauce, and chile flakes, then tossed with shallots, scallions, a fistful of mint and cilantro, and nutty homemade toasted rice powder. Spooned into butter lettuce cups with cool cucumber. Bright, herby, and on the table in under 30 minutes.

ingredients.name: ground turkey
ingredients.note: a dark-meat blend (85%) stays juiciest. Poultry.

ingredients.name: jasmine rice
ingredients.note: toasted and ground into khao khua (toasted rice powder) in the recipe

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: keeps the turkey in fine crumbles as it cooks

ingredients.name: limes
ingredients.preparation: juice 2 to get 1/4 cup; cut the third into wedges

ingredients.name: dried chile flakes
ingredients.display_name: Thai dried chile flakes or crushed red pepper
ingredients.note: medium heat; use 1/2 tsp for mild or up to 2 1/2 tsp for Thai-hot

ingredients.name: cilantro
ingredients.display_name: fresh cilantro leaves and tender stems

ingredients.name: butter lettuce
ingredients.note: 2 heads, about 16 cups. Lettuce variety; no dairy.

ingredients.name: English cucumber
ingredients.preparation: thinly sliced on a slight bias

steps.title: Prep the herbs, aromatics, and wraps
steps.body: Thinly slice the shallots and scallions. Pick and tear the mint; chop the cilantro. Separate, wash, and spin dry the lettuce leaves. Slice the cucumber. Juice 2 limes to get 1/4 cup and cut the third into wedges. About 10 minutes.

steps.title: Toast and grind the rice
steps.body: Put the 2 tbsp raw jasmine rice in a dry 12-inch skillet over medium heat. Toast, shaking and stirring constantly, until the grains are deep golden and smell like popcorn, about 5 minutes. Tip into a mortar or spice grinder and grind to coarse sand (about 1 minute). This is the toasted rice powder. About 6 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the turkey
steps.body: Return the same skillet to medium-high heat with the 1 tbsp oil. Add the turkey and the 3 tbsp water and break it into small crumbles with a spatula. Cook, stirring and breaking it up, until no pink remains, the liquid has evaporated, and a few bits are lightly browned, 6 to 8 minutes (165 F). About 8 minutes.

steps.title: Dress the larb
steps.body: Take the skillet off the heat and let it cool for 1 minute. Stir in the 3 tbsp fish sauce, the 1/4 cup lime juice, the 1 tsp sugar, and the chile flakes. Fold in the shallots, scallions, two-thirds of the toasted rice powder, and most of the mint and cilantro. Taste: it should be sharp, salty, and spicy; add a squeeze more lime or a dash of fish sauce if needed. About 3 minutes.

steps.title: Serve as wraps
steps.body: Pile the larb into a serving bowl or onto a platter. Scatter the remaining herbs and toasted rice powder on top. Arrange the lettuce cups, cucumber slices, and lime wedges alongside. To eat, spoon larb into a lettuce leaf, add cucumber, squeeze lime, and fold. About 2 minutes. kitchen_tested is false.

components.name: butter lettuce cups with cucumber and lime

equipment: mortar and pestle or spice grinder
recipe_version.time_clock: Prep 10 (herbs, aromatics, lettuce, cucumber, limes). Cook 19 = 6 toast/grind rice + 8 turkey + 3 dress + 2 serve. One skillet. No oven.
recipe_version.heat: Stovetop only. Medium dry heat to toast the rice; medium-high for the turkey. Dressing goes in off the heat. No oven.
recipe_version.doneness: Rice powder deep golden and nutty; turkey in fine crumbles, no pink (165 F), liquid evaporated; herbs bright and just barely wilted from the residual warmth. kitchen_tested is false.
